dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, did you watch the press conference this morning?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, dɪd juː ˈwɑːtʃ ðə ˈprɛs ˌkɑːnfərəns ˈðɪs ˈmɔːrnɪŋ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. The government announced a new plan to deal with the air pollution.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. ðə ˈɡʌvərnmənt əˈnaʊnst ə ˈnuː ˈplæn tə ˈdiːl wɪð ði ˈɛr pəˈluːʃən.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: The spokesperson said that schools would close on very bad days.
dialogue.reading: ðə ˈspoʊkspɜːrsən ˈsɛd ðæt ˈskuːlz wʊd ˈkloʊz ɑːn ˈvɛri ˈbæd ˈdeɪz.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: What about children? Will they get masks?
dialogue.reading: ˈwʌt əˈbaʊt ˈtʃɪldrən? wɪl ðeɪ ˈɡɛt ˈmæsks?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. She said that the city would give free masks to all children.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. ʃiː ˈsɛd ðæt ðə ˈsɪti wʊd ˈɡɪv ˈfriː ˈmæsks tə ˈɔːl ˈtʃɪldrən.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: And what about people who work in offices?
dialogue.reading: ənd ˈwʌt əˈbaʊt ˈpiːpəl huː ˈwɜːrk ɪn ˈɔːfɪsɪz?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: She said that companies could let their staff stay home.
dialogue.reading: ʃiː ˈsɛd ðæt ˈkʌmpəniz kʊd ˈlɛt ðɛr ˈstæf ˈsteɪ ˈhoʊm.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Is that official? I read a different statement online.
dialogue.reading: ɪz ðæt əˈfɪʃəl? aɪ ˈriːd ə ˈdɪfərənt ˈsteɪtmənt ˌɑːnˈlaɪn.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: The official statement is on the government's website. She said they would share more news next week.
dialogue.reading: ði əˈfɪʃəl ˈsteɪtmənt ɪz ɑːn ðə ˈɡʌvərnmənts ˈwɛbsaɪt. ʃiː ˈsɛd ðeɪ wʊd ˈʃɛr ˈmɔːr ˈnuːz ˈnɛkst ˈwiːk.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: OK. I'll check the website, then.
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. aɪl ˈtʃɛk ðə ˈwɛbsaɪt, ˈðɛn.
